name: Pregnanolone
summary: Pregnanolone, also known as eltanolone, is an endogenous inhibitory neurosteroid which is produced in the body from progesterone. It is closely related to allopregnanolone, which has similar properties.

pharmacology.text: Pregnanolone is a positive allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor, as well as a negative allosteric modulator of the glycine receptor.

uses.text: Pregnanolone was investigated for clinical use as a general anesthetic under the name eltanolone (INN), but produced unwanted side effects such as convulsions on occasion, and for this reason, was never marketed.

summaryZh: 孕烷醇酮也被稱為乙他諾隆（英語：eltanolone）是一種內源性的抑制性神經甾體，在體內由孕酮合成而來，和其異構體別孕烷醇酮有著類似的性質。
